late: Late submission is normally penalized. Students lose ten percent of the marks for each day a piece of work is late, and work that is more than five days late receives no marks at all. Illness extensions require medical evidence before the deadline. A student who is ill must contact the course coordinator before the deadline and provide a medical certificate that covers the days missed. Extensions are not given after the deadline has passed, even when the reason is illness. The coordinator records the new deadline in writing and the student must submit by that date. First year students have one separate first week rule: late uploads in the first week of the course are accepted without penalty, but this rule does not change the normal penalty for other students or for later weeks. If a student is unsure about a deadline, they should ask the coordinator early rather than waiting until the work is already late. The rules in this document apply to all coursework in the course, including essays, reports and practical work, and they are reviewed at the start of every term.
password: Reset a forgotten password using the recovery link. Go to the login page and click the link that says forgot password, then enter the email address on your account. A recovery message is sent to that address with a link that stays valid for one hour. Never share recovery codes. Recovery codes are private and staff will never ask for them in a message or a phone call. If a recovery message does not arrive, check the spam folder and wait ten minutes before asking for a new one. A new link cancels the old link, so only the newest message works. Choose a new password with at least eight characters and do not reuse a password from another site. After the password is changed, all other devices are signed out and must sign in again. If the account email is no longer available, contact the help desk with student identification so the account can be checked by hand.
assignment: Upload assignments through the learning portal. Open the course page, find the assignment, and use the upload button to add your file. Submit the final file as a PDF. Other file types are not marked, even when the content is correct, so check the file type before submitting. Only the last file uploaded before the deadline is marked. Earlier drafts are ignored. A submission receipt appears on screen after a successful upload, and students should save it. If the portal is down near the deadline, take a screenshot of the error and contact the coordinator at once. Work sent by email is not accepted unless the coordinator asks for it. File names should start with the student roll number so markers can find them easily. Group work is uploaded once by one member of the group, and all members share the same mark. Late uploads through the portal still follow the late submission rules in the late document.
contractor: Contractors can work remotely only if the signed contract permits it. Employee rules do not apply to contractors. An employee may request remote work with manager approval, but a contractor has no such request route. The contract must name remote work in writing before the work starts. A verbal promise from a manager is not enough. If the contract is silent on remote work, the contractor must work on site. Travel costs for on site work are paid only when the contract lists them. A contractor who works remotely without permission may have the work rejected and the hours unpaid. Changes to remote work permission need a written change to the contract signed by both sides. Contractors should read the remote work clause before signing, because it cannot be changed by email alone after the work has started. A contractor who is unsure should ask for the clause in writing before the first day of work.
printer: For blank printer pages, check ink levels and run the cleaning utility. Print a test page afterwards. The cleaning utility is found in the printer menu under maintenance, and it takes about two minutes to finish, during which the printer must not be switched off or unplugged, because stopping the cleaning early can leave ink in the wrong place and the next page can still come out blank even when the ink levels look fine on the screen. If the test page is still blank after cleaning, check that the paper tray holds the right size of paper and that the paper is loaded the right way up. A scanner with a blank image is a different problem and needs document placement checks instead. Follow the device manual for your exact model, because button names differ between models. If none of these steps help, record the error code shown on the screen and contact support with the model number.
